body:
Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ 2eb55177eb754d058efa7f22313b23d89ec2b364

Verdict CLEAN

No findings. Read #1584 and checked the changed row against the MCP handler, detection filter, and core geometry.

- Trial merge with upstream/main: already up to date.
- Documented grep pin: GREEN. Original-row mutation: RED (exit 1). Restored-row pin: GREEN (exit 0). Checked using grep inputs without editing tracked files. No runtime guards were added.
- cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main: GREEN; 0 steps, 0 failures, docs-only.
- git diff --check upstream/main: GREEN.
- Clippy: not applicable; no Rust crates changed. No Rust test binaries or live MCP session ran.
- Extra case beyond the grep pin: independently calculated the 34.928 mm through-hole limit for a 12 mm bull-nose tool with a 2 mm corner. A 35 mm hole exceeds it but is within the blind-hole limit. Source and documentation agree. This was a calculation and source check, not a runtime test.
- Policy checks: changed files are 199 and 9 lines. No new unwrap/expect/panic, goldens, PNGs, PROCESS_VERSION, dependencies, .github, or scripts changes. Body includes Changelog:, Fixes #1584, and Process change: yes.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2eb55177eb754d058efa7f22313b23d89ec2b364 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The two changed files contain documentation only. The reply fields, Bore diameter limit, skipped-hole messages, refusal before storage, boss detection, radial holes, and undo step agree with the source. No safety code, UI code, goldens, dependencies, build scripts, or workflows changed.

Local checks with upstream/main trial-merged:
- The trial merge was clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: two changed files, zero test steps, zero failures. The xtask build passed. No Rust test suite or clippy check was needed for these documentation changes.
- `git diff --check upstream/main` passed.
- The documentation pin passed. An in-memory copy of the original row failed the pin (RED). The current row passed again (GREEN). No tracked file was changed for this check.

The first gate run included unrelated upstream changes because the trial merge was not yet committed. I stopped that run, committed the local trial merge, and ran the gate again. The results above are from the second run.

No changes are requested. Current upstream AGENTS.md lines 290-309 require process PRs to leave PROCESS_VERSION unchanged and include `Process change: yes`. This PR meets that rule. The older review instructions in the starting checkout still require a branch version bump; that requirement has been replaced upstream.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
